item.text: I’m going to take a quick look around the workspace, then make one small, self-contained thing that feels worth keeping.
The workspace is empty, which is oddly freeing. I’m making a tiny offline “breathing sky” page—generative, calm, and useful as a one-minute reset.
Made [A Small Sky](/workspace/index.html): a self-contained, generative breathing page. Open it in a browser; click anywhere for new stars.
